title: Hidden Costs and Fast Fashion
summary: أهم كلمات Unit 10 (Behind the Buy) عن التكاليف الخفية والموضة السريعة والاستهلاك الواعي، بالمعنى الإنجليزي والعربي وأمثلة وتدريبات زي Review E.

blocks.text: الدرس ده عن إيه؟

text: This page collects the **key vocabulary of Unit 10: Behind the Buy**. Each word has a simple English meaning, the Arabic meaning and a short example. Then you will practise word families, collocations, prefixes and suffixes, synonyms and antonyms.

blocks.text: الصفحة دي فيها **أهم كلمات Unit 10: Behind the Buy**، متقسمة حسب دروس الوحدة. الوحدة بتتكلم عن **الاستهلاك الخفي (invisible consumption)**: التكاليف اللي مش مكتوبة على الفاتورة، زي التلوث وتعب العمال والزبالة، وعن **الموضة السريعة (fast fashion)**، والشرا علشان **اللايكات**، والحركات الشعبية اللي بتصلّح وتبدّل بدل ما ترمي.

الكلمات دي متاخدة من نصوص الوحدة وجداول الـ **Vocabulary** و**Media Analysis: Key Concepts** في الكتاب: **10.1 Hidden Cost of a Click** (التوصيل المجاني والمرتجعات)، **10.2 Chasing Validation** (الشرا علشان اللايكات)، **10.3 The True Price of Fast Fashion** (التيشيرت الرخيص)، **10.4 Rethinking What We Buy** (ثريد FixItTogetherEG وحركة الـ swap)، وكمان **Consolidation Review E**.
إزاي تذاكر الكلمات صح؟

text: Do not learn a word alone. Learn its **meaning in context**, its **family** (noun, verb, adjective, adverb) and the words that usually go **with** it (collocations).

blocks.text: أسئلة الكتاب والمراجعات مش بتسألك «ترجم الكلمة» وخلاص. بتحطلك الكلمة **جوه جملة** وتسألك معناها **في السياق ده** (What does … mean in this context?)، أو تطلب منك **تغيّر شكل الكلمة** (noun / adjective / adverb)، أو تطلع **مرادف أو عكس** من قطعة. علشان كده ذاكر كل كلمة بالطريقة دي:

items: **اقرا المثال الأول** وافهم الكلمة من الجملة قبل ما تبص على الترجمة.
**احفظ المعنى الإنجليزي البسيط**، لأن الاختيارات في الـ MCQ بتيجي تعريفات بالإنجليزي.
**اعرف عيلة الكلمة**: الاسم والفعل والصفة والظرف.
**اعرف الكلمة بتيجي مع إيه** (collocation) زي make an informed choice مش do an informed choice.
**اكتب جملة بنفسك** عن موضوع الوحدة بكل كلمة جديدة. الكتاب بيطلب كده في Practice: Write FOUR sentences using words from the text.

blocks.text: كلمات 10.1: The Hidden Cost of a Click
النص بيشرح اللي بيحصل بين ما تدوس **buy now** ولحد ما الطرد يوصل بابك: مخازن وعمال وعربيات نص فاضية ومرتجعات بتترمي.

items: convenience
السهولة / الراحة · the quality of being easy, quick or effortless · مثال: Online shopping offers great **convenience**.
fulfilment centre
مركز تجهيز الطلبات (مخزن ضخم) · a large warehouse where online orders are prepared · مثال: Workers walk kilometres in a **fulfilment centre**. (الكتاب بيكتبها fulfillment center)
emissions
انبعاثات (غازات ملوِّثة) · gases released into the air, often causing pollution · مثال: Delivery vans produce carbon **emissions**.
landfill
مقلب زبالة (مدفن نفايات) · a site where waste is buried · مثال: Returned clothes are often sent to **landfill**.
inherently
بطبيعته · by its very nature · مثال: Online shopping is not **inherently** wrong.
consolidated
مجمّع في شحنة واحدة · combined into a single, more efficient unit · مثال: **Consolidated** orders mean fewer van trips.
informed (choice)
(اختيار) مبني على معرفة · having enough accurate knowledge to decide sensibly · مثال: Shoppers need facts to make an **informed choice**.
warehouse
مخزن · a large building where goods are stored · مثال: The item waits in a **warehouse**.
parcel
طرد · a wrapped package sent by post · مثال: The **parcel** arrived two days later.
refund
استرداد الفلوس · money given back when you return something · مثال: The customer gets a free, painless **refund**.
restock
يرجّع للمخزون · to put goods back on sale · مثال: It is cheaper to destroy an item than to **restock** it.
checkout
مكان / مرحلة الدفع · the point where you pay for what you buy · مثال: The real cost does not appear at **checkout**.

blocks.text: كلمات 10.2: Chasing Validation
التسجيل عن الشرا علشان **رد فعل الناس على السوشيال ميديا** مش علشان الحاجة نفسها.

items: validation
القبول / الاعتراف (من الناس) · approval or recognition from other people · مثال: Some teenagers post to get **validation**.
validation-driven buying
الشرا علشان استحسان الناس · buying motivated by the wish for approval · مثال: **Validation-driven buying** is shaped by likes.
anticipated
متوقَّع · expected before it happens · مثال: She bought it for the **anticipated** reaction.
anxiety
قلق · a feeling of worry or nervousness · مثال: Posting every day can cause **anxiety**.
disguised (as)
متنكّر في شكل / متخبّي · hidden or made to look like something else · مثال: Adverts arrive **disguised as** friendship.
dopamine
الدوبامين (مادة السعادة في المخ) · a chemical in the brain linked to pleasure and reward · مثال: Each like releases a little **dopamine**.
implicit
ضمني (مش مقول صراحة) · suggested but not directly stated · مثال: The post has an **implicit** message: buy this.
persuasive
مقنع · able to make someone believe or do something · مثال: Influencers can be more **persuasive** than adverts.
influencer marketing
التسويق عن طريق المؤثرين · selling products through popular social media users · مثال: **Influencer marketing** feels like advice from a friend.
audience
الجمهور · the people who watch or read something · مثال: Some purchases satisfy an **audience**, not a need.

blocks.text: كلمات 10.3: The True Price of Fast Fashion
النص بيحسب التكلفة الحقيقية لتيشيرت رخيص: أكتر من **2500 لتر مية**، وأجور قليلة، وهدوم بتترمي بعد 7 لـ 10 لبسات.

items: fast fashion
الموضة السريعة · cheap clothes made quickly to follow new trends · مثال: **Fast fashion** is worn only a few times.
garment
قطعة ملابس · a piece of clothing · مثال: Each **garment** has a hidden cost.
textile
نسيج / قماش · a type of cloth or woven fabric · مثال: The **textile** industry uses huge amounts of water.
bargain
لقطة (حاجة رخيصة) · something bought for less than its usual price · مثال: A T-shirt for the price of a coffee looks like a **bargain**.
living wage
أجر يكفي للمعيشة · pay that is enough for a decent life · مثال: Many workers earn a fraction of a **living wage**.
compressed
مضغوط / متقلّص · reduced or squeezed into a smaller amount · مثال: Labour costs are **compressed** to keep prices low.
disposable
بيترمي بعد الاستعمال · designed to be thrown away after use · مثال: Cheap clothes feel **disposable**.
incinerated
اتحرق (اتخلصوا منه بالحرق) · burned deliberately to destroy waste · مثال: Tons of clothes are **incinerated** every year.
synthetic fibres
ألياف صناعية · man-made threads like polyester · مثال: **Synthetic fibres** make recycling difficult.
second-hand
مستعمل (الكتاب بيكتبها secondhand) · previously owned by someone else · مثال: Buying **second-hand** reduces waste.
sustainable
مستدام (مش بيضر البيئة) · able to continue without lasting damage to the environment · مثال: Some brands sell **sustainable** collections.
greenwashing
الغسيل الأخضر (ادعاء كاذب إنه صديق للبيئة) · making a company look more eco-friendly than it really is · مثال: Critics call these claims **greenwashing**.

blocks.text: كلمات 10.4: Rethinking What We Buy
ثريد عن **Repair Café** في المعادي صلّح 34 حاجة ببلاش، وتسجيل عن جروب **Buy Nothing** اللي الناس بتبدّل فيه حاجاتها.

items: circular economy
الاقتصاد الدائري · a system that reuses and repairs products instead of throwing them away · مثال: Repair cafés support a **circular economy**.
repair café
مقهى التصليح · an event where volunteers fix broken things for free · مثال: The **repair café** fixed toasters and backpacks.
mindful consumption
الاستهلاك الواعي · buying with awareness of the wider impact · مثال: **Mindful consumption** means asking "Do I need it?"
minimalism
البساطة (التقليل من الممتلكات) · a lifestyle of owning fewer, carefully chosen things · مثال: **Minimalism** helps families save money.
swap event
فعالية تبادل · a gathering where people exchange things instead of buying · مثال: She gave away a jacket at a **swap event**.
informal
مش رسمي · not part of an official system · مثال: The swap group is completely **informal**.
suspicious
متشكك / مريب · feeling that something may be wrong · مثال: People are **suspicious** of free things.
catch (noun)
عيب خفي (فيها إن) · a hidden problem in something that seems good · مثال: "It's free? What's the **catch**?"
estimate
يقدّر تقريبًا / تقدير · to judge the approximate amount of something · مثال: Organisers **estimate** they saved two tons of waste.
tons
أطنان (بالبريطاني بتتكتب كمان tonnes) · large units of weight · مثال: **Tons** of clothes end up in landfill.
industrial
صناعي (على نطاق المصانع) · relating to large-scale factory production · مثال: Swap groups cannot replace **industrial** change.

blocks.text: عيلة الكلمة (Word Families)

text: Many questions ask for **the correct form of the word in brackets**. Learn the noun, verb, adjective and adverb together.

blocks.text: الجدول ده فيه أشهر عيلات الكلمات في الوحدة. أهم عيلة هي **consume** لأنها موضوع الوحدة كلها:
إزاي أعرف محتاج أنهي شكل من الكلمة؟

text: Look at the word **before** and **after** the gap. The position tells you if you need a noun, a verb, an adjective or an adverb.

blocks.text: في سؤال **Complete the sentences using the correct form of the word in brackets** بص على مكان الفراغ:
كلمات بتيجي مع بعض (Collocations)

text: A **collocation** is a group of words that native speakers usually use together. Using them makes your writing sound natural.

blocks.text: الـ collocation يعني كلمتين «متجوزين»: لازم تستخدمهم مع بعض. احفظهم كده:

rows: Shoppers cannot **make an informed choice** without facts.
Most fast fashion **ends up in landfill**.
Some teens **chase likes** with every purchase.
**Flash sales** push people to buy quickly.

blocks.text: البادئات واللواحق (Prefixes & Suffixes)

text: A **prefix** comes at the start of a word and often changes its meaning. A **suffix** comes at the end and often changes the word class (noun, adjective…).

blocks.text: الوحدة دي مليانة كلمات بتبدأ بـ **re-** (تاني) لأنها عن إعادة الاستخدام:

rows: repair, reuse, recycle, resell, restock, repackage

blocks.text: المرادفات والأضداد (Synonyms & Antonyms)

text: Reviews ask for synonyms and antonyms in context, or which situation best shows a word's meaning.

blocks.text: فقرة بالكلمات الجديدة
اقرا الفقرة دي وركّز على الكلمات اللي بالـ bold. كلها من الوحدة:

text: Last month, Laila saw a dress on a **flash sale** for just 150 pounds. It looked like a **bargain**, and an influencer she followed was wearing the same one. The **anticipated** likes made the dress even more attractive. However, before she reached **checkout**, she remembered a lesson about **fast fashion**. A single cheap **garment** can use thousands of litres of water, and many workers do not earn a **living wage**. Clothes like this are often worn a few times and then **end up in landfill**.

Laila decided to make an **informed choice**. She went to a **swap event** at her youth centre instead, and she found a **second-hand** dress in perfect condition. Some of her friends were **suspicious** at first: "What's the **catch**?" But there was none. Laila now believes that **mindful consumption** is not about buying nothing. It is about seeing the **hidden costs** that the price tag never shows.

blocks.text: لاحظ: الفقرة فيها collocations زي **make an informed choice** و**end up in landfill** و**hidden costs**، وكلمات بعكس بعض زي second-hand و brand-new.

blocks.title: أشهر الأخطاء (غلط ← صح)
items: ✗ Responsible consume can reduce waste. ← ✓ Responsible **consumption** can reduce waste. (بعد صفة = اسم)
✗ consumer = الاستهلاك ← ✓ **consumer** = المستهلك (شخص)، **consumption** = الاستهلاك
✗ disposal plates ← ✓ **disposable** plates (قبل الاسم = صفة). disposal = التخلص من الحاجة
✗ The ad is persuade. ← ✓ The ad is **persuasive**.
✗ green washing = غسيل بالمية ← ✓ **greenwashing** = ادعاء كاذب إن الشركة صديقة للبيئة
✗ a large number of water ← ✓ a large **amount** of water (المية مش بتتعد)

blocks.title: حيلة سريعة للحفظ وللامتحان
items: **re-** = تاني: كل كلمة بتبدأ بيها في الوحدة دي معناها «نعمل الحاجة تاني بدل ما نرمي».
**implicit ↔ explicit**: implicit = مفهوم من غير ما يتقال، explicit = متقال صراحة.
في سؤال **Which situation best reflects the meaning** (زي emission في Review E): ترجم الكلمة الأول، وبعدين دوّر على الموقف اللي فيه **نفس الفكرة بالظبط** (غازات ودخان طالع في الهوا).

blocks.text: إزاي بييجي في الأسئلة؟
الأسئلة في الكتاب والمراجعات بتيجي بالأشكال دي. هنحل مثال لكل شكل:
**1) Which situation best reflects the meaning of the word?**

text: "Our town's emissions have doubled in ten years." Which situation best reflects the meaning of "emissions"?
a. A shop stores boxes in a large warehouse.   b. A factory releases thick smoke and gases all day.   c. A market is full of loud noise.   d. A customer returns a dress for a refund.

blocks.text: **الإجابة: b.** emissions = غازات ودخان بيطلعوا في الهوا. الاختيارات التانية فيها كلمات من الوحدة (warehouse / refund) بس معناها مختلف.
**2) Choose the correct answer: A fashion brand advertises one "green" jacket while most of its clothes still pollute rivers. This is called…**

text: a. minimalism   b. upcycling   c. greenwashing   d. citizen science

blocks.text: **الإجابة: c. greenwashing.** الكلمة اتشرحت في 10.3 والمراجعة بتسأل عليها بالتعريف.
**3) Complete the sentence using the correct form of the word in brackets.**

text: Responsible ________ (consume) can reduce waste and unnecessary purchases.

blocks.text: **الإجابة: consumption.** بعد الصفة responsible وقبل الفعل can محتاجين **اسم** (فاعل).
تدريب
**A. Choose the correct answer from a, b, c or d.**

items.q:
1. Validation-driven buying is shaped by the reaction a person expects from an online audience. "Validation-driven" means ________.
a. based on usefulness  b. controlled by laws  c. motivated by the desire for approval  d. caused by a lack of products

2. A large warehouse where online orders are prepared for delivery is a ________.
a. landfill  b. fulfilment centre  c. repair café  d. swap event

3. Plastic cups that are designed to be thrown away after one use are ________.
a. durable  b. second-hand  c. disposable  d. consolidated

4. The advert does not say "buy this", but its message is clear. The message is ________.
a. implicit  b. explicit  c. compressed  d. industrial
items.a: **a. implicit** — مفهوم من غير ما يتقال.

items.q:
5. An economic system that aims to reuse and repair products rather than discard them is a ________.
a. fast fashion  b. circular economy  c. labour market  d. flash sale

6. When people were offered free items, some asked, "What's the catch?" Here "catch" means ________.
a. a hidden problem  b. a big discount  c. a type of fish  d. a delivery date

7. Shoppers who know the real cost of a product can make a/an ________ choice.
a. disguised  b. informed  c. suspicious  d. anxious

blocks.text: **B. Complete the sentences using the correct form of the word in brackets.**

items.q: 8. Influencer posts can be more ________ (persuade) than traditional adverts.
9. Many young people feel ________ (anxiety) when their posts get few likes.
10. Online shopping offers ________ (convenient) for people with limited mobility.
11. Cars and factories release harmful ________ (emit).
12. Swap groups are useful, but they cannot replace large-scale ________ (industry) change.
13. The organisers checked every photo to improve the ________ (rely) of their posts.

blocks.text: **C. Find words in the text that are synonyms or antonyms of the words below.**

text: Nada used to buy brand-new clothes every month. The adverts looked friendly, but their real aim was hidden. One day, she joined an unofficial swap group in her neighbourhood. At first she was doubtful, but the members were kind and convincing. Now she keeps her clothes for years because she wants them to be long-lasting.

15. A synonym of "disguised"
16. A synonym of "informal"
17. A synonym of "suspicious"
18. An antonym of "disposable"

blocks.text: **D. Complete the sentences using words from the box.**

text: greenwashing – landfill – living wage – bargain – mindful consumption – swap event

items.q: 19. A T-shirt for the price of a coffee looks like a ________.
20. Thousands of returned items are sent to ________ every year.
21. Garment workers should earn a ________, not a fraction of it.
22. A brand that sells one small eco-friendly line while polluting the rest of the time may be guilty of ________.
23. At the ________, people exchanged books and clothes instead of buying new ones.
24. ________ means thinking about the wider impact before you buy.

blocks.title: ملخص الدرس في سطرين
items: كلمات الوحدة بتدور حول: **الشرا أونلاين** (convenience, emissions, landfill, informed)، **اللايكات** (validation, anticipated, implicit, persuasive)، **الموضة السريعة** (garment, living wage, disposable, greenwashing) و**الحلول** (circular economy, repair café, swap event, mindful consumption).
عيلة consume: **consume** (فعل) / **consumption** (الاستهلاك) / **consumer** (المستهلك).
**disposable ↔ durable**، **second-hand ↔ brand-new**، **implicit ↔ explicit**، **informal ↔ official**.
في سؤال **which situation best reflects** ترجم الكلمة الأول ودوّر على نفس الفكرة بالظبط.
